text:
- **Codex session replies:** An idle Codex session now wakes when the owner replies. The pm service queues each reply into a live Codex session. A live parity test passed on Codex.
- **Public site login:** The public pm site now requires a valid Cloudflare Access token. A request without a valid token is refused. The owner logged in and confirmed that the site loads.
- **Website install and credits:** The website install commands now point to the latest release. A Credits section for Beads and Dolt now appears in the README and website.
- **Code checks and design pages:** A check now refuses race test names that match no top-level test. Design pages now name the code they cover.
